text:
Jen (support): Customer ACME reporting intermittent 502/504s on hosted inference during long streaming chat sessions after a midnight autoscale. They're seeing p99 spikes and stream resets. Sample trace: tx-8f3a2b. Attached logs + curl repro.

Kevin (SRE): ack — can you paste the trace and any edge node ids? timing correlation with deploy/scale?

Jen (support): trace tx-8f3a2b logs:
```
[edge] 2026-02-18T03:12:45Z envoy upstream reset: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset_reason: connection failure
[edge] 2026-02-18T03:12:45Z tls: handshake error: tls: no certificates configured or session resume failed
[upstream] 2026-02-18T03:12:46Z backend accepted then closed during streaming chunk
```
Node: edge-az1-021 (from trace). Customer says it reproduces ~50% of long sessions (>30s) when they send streaming messages.

Anita (Ingress): I see a rolling node replacement around 03:12 UTC in k8s (autoscaler replaced 2 nodes). Envoy CDS/EDS updates happened concurrently and we have cluster health flapping recorded for cluster "upstream-hostedapi". Quick check on the node: `curl -sS http://localhost:9901/stats?filter=cluster.upstream-hostedapi` shows increased `cluster.upstream-hostedapi.membership_changed` and `cluster.upstream-hostedapi.upstream_rq_5xx`. Also conn pool stats look weird: `cluster.upstream-hostedapi.conn_pool_close` spiked.

ingress-bot: alert: ingress.edge.502_rate increased 420% at 2026-02-18T03:13:00Z; p99_latency edge-hostedapi jumped 2.9s -> 15.2s.

Kevin (SRE): hypothesis: TLS session resumption/session ticket keys were rotated or lost during node replacement, causing existing keepalive/long-lived connections to fail TLS resume and drop mid-stream. Envoy then reports upstream connect error and returns 502 to client. Also possible: partial upstream pool drain + new upstreams rejecting early frames during TLS renegotiation.

Maria (support): customer timeline matches — they reported spike exactly at autoscale window. They have SLA impact, want ETA.

Kevin (SRE): immediate mitigations:
1) If rolling update still running - pause or rollback the node pool to avoid further session key churn: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/ingress -n prod` or `kubectl rollout undo ...` as needed.
2) Increase Envoy TLS handshake timeout and soften conn pool aggressive drain to allow in-flight streams to complete. Example change: `tls_context.common_tls_context.tls_params.tls_max_handshake_time` bump.
3) Temporary route-level fallback: route streaming traffic to a more stable pool (older instances) via service tag.

Anita (Ingress): I'll check node drain settings and whether session ticket keys are stored only on node local disk. If so, we should enable a shared session ticket store (k/v or redis) or switch to TLS passthrough for streaming endpoints. For now I'll set gracefulDrain: 60s and increase `upstream_rq_timeout` by 5s.

Jen (support): repro steps for customer to reproduce (provided back to them):
```bash
# long-lived streaming repro (curl chunked)
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -X POST https://hosted.redwood.example/v1/streaming-chat \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-stream","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"start"}]}'
# then send periodic keepalives after 20s to observe mid-stream reset
```
Add trace header: `X-Redwood-Trace: tx-8f3a2b`

Kevin (SRE): followups: Anita will roll the ingress config change in the next 10m and monitor 502 rate. If no improvement, we'll perform a controlled rollback of the node pool. I'll update with metrics link.

Anita (Ingress): config change pushed to canary (ingress-canary) — increased drain and handshake timeout. Monitoring now: https://grafana.internal/d/ingress/edge?panel=502-rate&from=now-30m

ingress-bot: info: canary config applied at 2026-02-18T03:21:00Z.

Maria (support): flagged as P1 for ACME, providing ETA to customer: "We have an active remediation in canary and will update within 30 minutes."

Jen (support): thanks — will keep ACME on the loop, collecting any additional trace ids. Please ping if we need to trigger rollback.

Kevin (SRE): noted. owners: Anita (Ingress) primary, Kevin (SRE) secondary. updating incident channel.
